monitoring_metric: MODEL_VERSION, model_inventory.csv model_version, run_manifest_summary.csv model_version, README, CHANGELOG, dashboard, and PDF references
frequency: Each release and full pipeline run
threshold_or_trigger: Any mismatch between config.py MODEL_VERSION and generated governance or report artifacts
response: Import MODEL_VERSION from config.py in generated artifacts and rerun main.py after version changes.

monitoring_metric: Connector status and row count
threshold_or_trigger: Any key source switches from live to fallback
response: Flag in report, review source change, avoid overstating outputs.

monitoring_metric: Feature rows, oblast rows, oblast-sector rows, scoring candidate rows, top candidate, current_use, prohibited_use, and production_score_change
threshold_or_trigger: Feature artifacts are missing, mapping coverage drops unexpectedly, current_use changes from review_artifact_only, prohibited_use changes from direct_scoring_without_change_control, or production_score_change changes from none
response: Regenerate src.prozorro_procurement_features outputs, review mapping and coverage, and block any production scoring use until SME review and model change-control approval are documented.

monitoring_metric: Top 10 score changes and oblast/sector ranking changes
threshold_or_trigger: Large unexplained ranking shifts
response: Review input changes, source coverage, and transformation logic.

monitoring_metric: Dominant risk layer in top signals
threshold_or_trigger: One layer dominates most top outputs
response: Review weighting, scaling, and possible data imbalance.

monitoring_metric: Oblast conflict proxy distribution
threshold_or_trigger: Extreme compression, missing oblasts, or unexpected zeros
response: Review mapping, log scaling, sample date range, and event types.

monitoring_metric: Number of mapped NBU/Ukrstat candidate indicators by layer
threshold_or_trigger: Major change in candidate indicator count or names
response: Review Ukrstat/NBU API changes and update mapping rules.

monitoring_metric: Candidate count, successful probes, observation count, and latest period
threshold_or_trigger: Candidate count drops below expected oblast coverage, observations disappear, or latest-period coverage changes unexpectedly
response: Hold scoring integration, review SDMX route, verify DSD/codelist changes, and document any period or unit changes.

monitoring_metric: current_use_in_scoring and validation_status fields
threshold_or_trigger: Any official baseline candidate changes from not_yet_used before validation evidence is documented
response: Block release, reset scoring status, and require validation evidence before official values affect scores.

monitoring_metric: decision, approved_current_use, prohibited_current_use
threshold_or_trigger: Decision changes to scoring integration or prohibited_current_use changes before validation evidence and SME review are documented
response: Block release and require review of official_baseline_validation_register.csv and official_baseline_readiness_decision.csv.

monitoring_metric: Review-required, partial, high, or critical validation checks
threshold_or_trigger: Any high or critical review item remains open
response: Keep official baseline values in controlled benchmark-integration context only and do not use them in risk layers or composite scores.

monitoring_metric: Scenario count, benchmark rows, rescale rows, replace-baseline rows
threshold_or_trigger: Merge-plan artifacts are missing, scenario count changes unexpectedly, or any artifact is described as production scoring input
response: Regenerate official_baseline_merge_plan.py outputs and block any scoring use until transformation logic and SME review are documented.

monitoring_metric: Gap-review rows, recommendation rows, largest gap, and recommended current posture
threshold_or_trigger: Merge-review artifacts are missing, recommended posture is not benchmark_only, or largest-gap results change unexpectedly
response: Regenerate official_baseline_merge_review.py outputs, review large-gap oblasts, and keep official values out of scoring until SME review and change control are documented.

monitoring_metric: Memo availability, benchmark_only posture, scoring prohibition, and gap finding text
threshold_or_trigger: Memo is missing, does not include benchmark_only, omits the scoring prohibition, or fails to describe official-vs-synthetic gap findings
response: Regenerate official_baseline_review_memo.py outputs and block external presentation until the memo accurately reflects the current control posture.

monitoring_metric: Register rows, layer-map rows, summary rows, current_use, prohibited_use, and production_score_change
threshold_or_trigger: Typology artifacts are missing, current_use changes from literature_support_and_typology_reference_only, prohibited_use changes from direct_scoring_without_change_control, or production_score_change changes from none
response: Regenerate src.wartime_aml_typology_register outputs and block any scoring use until official data mapping, SME review, false-positive controls, and change control are documented.

monitoring_metric: Source-register rows, reporting-stat rows, case-referral rows, typology-support rows, summary rows, current_use, prohibited_use, production_score_change, used_in_waris_scoring, and used_in_monte_carlo
threshold_or_trigger: FIU/SFMS artifacts are missing, current_use changes from official_fiu_context_and_typology_support_only, production_score_change changes from none, or any scoring/Monte Carlo flag becomes true
response: Regenerate src.fiu_official_context outputs, review source documents, and block any scoring use until validation, SME review, and change control are documented.

monitoring_metric: Queue rows, review-question rows, disposition-template rows, human_review_required, automated_adverse_action_allowed, entity_level_findings_allowed, and production_score_change
threshold_or_trigger: Queue artifacts are missing, production_score_change changes from none, or any adverse-action/entity-finding flag changes from False
response: Regenerate analyst_review_queue.py outputs and block external presentation until review-only controls are restored.

monitoring_metric: Risk-register rows, control rows, checklist rows, control-status counts, and production_score_change
threshold_or_trigger: False-positive artifacts are missing, any control is review_required without explanation, or production_score_change changes from none
response: Regenerate false_positive_controls.py outputs and review any control that does not pass before relying on analyst-review outputs.

monitoring_metric: Inventory rows, assessment rows, replacement-priority rows, freshness status counts, refresh-priority counts, and overall freshness posture
threshold_or_trigger: Any required artifact is missing, empty, aging, or stale, or the overall freshness posture changes unexpectedly
response: Use source_freshness_replacement_priorities.csv to refresh source families and avoid overstating stale or missing artifacts.

monitoring_metric: Run ID, model version, production_score_change, output inventory, git status, and JSON manifest availability
threshold_or_trigger: Run manifest is missing, production_score_change changes from none, or output inventory does not include expected governance artifacts
response: Regenerate run_manifest.py outputs and preserve run metadata before publishing or comparing runs.

monitoring_metric: Probability of elevated-or-high review priority
threshold_or_trigger: High score but low robustness, or robustness deterioration
response: Flag as fragile signal; require additional validation before use.

monitoring_metric: Use case and output granularity
threshold_or_trigger: Any proposed entity-level or operational use
response: Reject use unless governance, validation, and lawful data controls are added.
